Introduction

Complete REST API for WideHalo ERP system.

Base URL: http://localhost 
This documentation aims to provide all the information you need to work with our API.

<aside>As you scroll, you'll see code examples for working with the API in different programming languages in the dark area to the right (or as part of the content on mobile).
You can switch the language used with the tabs at the top right (or from the nav menu at the top left on mobile).</aside>

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

You can retrieve your token by visiting your dashboard and clicking Generate API token.

Accounting - AI

AI-powered accounting analysis and suggestions.

POST api/v1/accounting/ai/detect-anomalies

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost/api/v1/accounting/ai/detect-anomalies" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"entries\": []
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost/api/v1/accounting/ai/detect-anomalies"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "entries": []
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
Received response:
Request failed with error:


Tip: Check that you're properly connected to the network.
If you're a maintainer of ths API, verify that your API is running and you've enabled CORS.
You can check the Dev Tools console for debugging information.

Request      

POST api/v1/accounting/chart-of-accounts

Headers

Authorization        

Example: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}

Content-Type        

Example: application/json

Accept        

Example: application/json

Body Parameters

code   string     

Must not be greater than 50 characters. Example: b

name   string     

Must not be greater than 255 characters. Example: n

type   string     

Example: liability

Must be one of:
  • asset
  • liability
  • equity
  • revenue
  • expense
description   string  optional    

Example: Eius et animi quos velit et.

parent_id   string  optional    

The id of an existing record in the acc_chart_of_accounts table.

is_active   boolean  optional    

Example: true

GET api/v1/accounting/chart-of-accounts/{chart_of_account_id}

requires authentication

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://localhost/api/v1/accounting/chart-of-accounts/architecto" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_KEY}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost/api/v1/accounting/chart-of-accounts/architecto"

Receive inbound WhatsApp messages from Meta.

Must include a valid X-Hub-Signature-256 header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body signed with WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET). Messages are persisted and queued for AI handling.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost/api/whatsapp/webhook" \
    --header "X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=&lt;hmac_of_body&gt; required" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost/api/whatsapp/webhook"
);

const headers = {
    "X-Hub-Signature-256": "sha256=&lt;hmac_of_body&gt; required",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());
